caveat: UNVERIFIED Class B expert recall. Platform-owner discussion list — not Class A fact.
open_list_note: The mitigation library is append-only. Adding new M-entries is an ongoing developer responsibility as the sheet and operator uploads grow. Do not overwrite historical rows.

gaps.title: Mass recruitment vs key-hire timing is not one date
gaps.detail: GM ideally T-12; Engineering and Housekeeping need to be in post by T-3 for commissioning inheritance and snag discovery; general mass recruitment sits T-3–6. Fallback is a sister-property task force, which is a different risk profile than a hired department head.

gaps.title: C&E matrix vs individual tests
gaps.detail: Individual fire/life-safety tests can pass while the integrated interfaced response fails (detection → dampers → pressurisation → lifts → door release → BMS). Never infer integrated function from unit tests.

gaps.title: Fire/CD is the computed last licensing approval
gaps.detail: Occupancy/completion is paced by the last approval on the licensing path. That node is computed from the prerequisite graph, not a hardcoded lead-time constant. Disputed attribution extends the delay.

gaps.title: OS&E fit/function failure
gaps.detail: Goods can be delivered on programme and still be unusable (clock with no socket). Upstream: BOQ freeze, operator engagement, long-lead flag, sample approval.

gaps.title: Asset register ownership
gaps.detail: Ideal: Owner-developed + Operator-maintained. Fallback: Operator-alone. BIM-driven Owner path is the most accurate origin — the platform still ingests only a structured extract.

gaps.title: No BIM file ingest
gaps.detail: A BIM-origin register is welcome as a source note. The platform never parses IFC/Navisworks/Aconex/Procore.

gaps.title: Sheet facts stay Class B until owner artefacts exist
gaps.detail: Promote a row to Class A only when brand standards, manning, OS&E matrices, licence trackers, or PPM records are uploaded.

gaps.title: FF&E vs OS&E is the wrong contest
gaps.detail: Approvers are distributed (designer → optional operator → owner budget); procurement is centralized Owner-via-agent. The real hole is unassigned operational items (IPTV/displays, desk power) — checkpoint M-6.

gaps.title: Delayed T&C forces acceptance
gaps.detail: Category C handover timing: late testing and commissioning pushes the operator into conditional acceptance; snags continue after opening.

gaps.title: Category D commercial drag
gaps.detail: DLP-deferred defects, out-of-scope testing disputes, and late attic stock/spares keep dragging after M-15.

gaps.title: Mitigation library is append-only
gaps.detail: M-1–M-15 is the current sheet set. New operator or brand findings are appended; they are not a reason to empty this file.
